properties.NAME: GREER
properties.CHANGE: GREER created by Texas from Young Terr. (Tex.). GREER located entirely in present Okla., but Tex. claimed area based on belief that the N. Fork of Red Riv. was the main channel. GREER overlapped Indian Terr. and, after 2 May 1890, part of Okla. Terr.
properties.CITATION: (Texas Laws 1859, 8th leg., reg. sess., gen., ch. 90/p. 138)
